summary: Tempest Therapeutics filed an 8-K disclosing a warrant exercise inducement letter with a holder of existing warrants originally issued in November 2025. The holder exercised 1,172,414 shares at a reduced price of $1.73 per share (from $3.50) for ~$2M gross proceeds. As consideration, the company issued a new warrant to purchase up to 2,344,828 shares at $1.73, exercisable upon stockholder approval and expiring May 29, 2028. H.C. Wainwright acted as placement agent, receiving a warrant for 82,069 shares at $2.1625. A resale registration statement will be filed. This is a capital-raising transaction with inducement warrants, not a traditional special situation—no change of control, merger, activist campaign, or restructuring. What to watch: stockholder approval for new warrant exercisability and registration effectiveness.
